messages:
maya (Sales): Heads-up — BeaconBank SIG is due tomorrow morning. They want question-by-question evidence for encryption, key rotation, and isolation. I started a raw table in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SALES/pages/BeaconBank+SIG
ethan (Solutions): Thanks — can you call out owners for each section? I'll volunteer for 'network segmentation' and 'deployment topology'.
maya (Sales): Added owners inline. Quick ask: can security attach the KMS rotation proof? Beacon asked for last 12 months logs.
riya (Security): We have a rotated-keys report in S3. Path: s3://redwood-sec-artifacts/beaconbank/sig/key-rotation-2024.zip. But need approval to share — contains key IDs.
alex (Sales Ops): If it's restricted, we can create a redacted PDF that shows timestamps and rotation activity without exposing key material. Works for most vendors.
tom (Engineering): For deployment topology, I'll paste the snippet they want to see: ```VPCs: prod-pprod (10.0.0.0/16), private subnets only; Bastion access via SSO; No public IPs on model hosts``` Can upload architecture diagram to Confluence.
riya (Security): Also need SOC2 evidence for access reviews — I can pull the IAM audit report (SUP-4521). It's on the audit server: https://audit.redwood.internal/reports/SUP-4521.pdf. Will request sanitized copy.
deploy-bot: Deployment event: sig-evidence-export job started by riya at 16:05 UTC
ethan (Solutions): Beacon also asked for a short explanation of fallback policies (model downgrade, region failover). Can someone draft 2-3 bullet points?
tom (Engineering): Draft: "1) Smart routing prefers low-latency variants; 2) Region fallback to nearest cold replica; 3) Automatic model-variant downgrade with quality gates and alerting." Keep it tight.
maya (Sales): Perfect. Riya — can you confirm if the KMS report + IAM audit + architecture diagram satisfies encryption+access questions? If so I'll upload to the SIG portal and ping their security lead.
riya (Security): Yes, combo should satisfy. One caveat: we need to redact ARNs and rotate IDs; I'll produce a redacted package and checksum it. ETA 2 hours.
alex (Sales Ops): Once we have final PDFs, I can bundle into the vendor portal format (CSV index + ZIP) and submit. Also, what's our ask on the PII handling question? Beacon wants specifics on data residency for embeddings.
ethan (Solutions): For embeddings: customer content is not stored by default; we support VPC/private deployments and per-customer storage in their region. Suggest this reply: short yes/no + link to Private deployment docs.
maya (Sales): I'll craft the prose and tag legal if needed. Last thing: can we surface the size of the evidence package before upload? Avoid heavy attachments in portal.
riya (Security): Final package will be ~12MB (PDFs + diagram). I'll upload to internal secure share and send link.
ninja (note): small typo — none.
maya (Sales): Thanks team — once uploaded I'll hit submit and log it under the BeaconBank deal in Salesforce (Opportunity 67890). Ping here when done :thumbsup:
